newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real falls 0.4 pct on higher dlr outflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real falls 0.4 pct on higher dlr outflows.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.43 percent to close at 1.0580 reais per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market on higher dollar outflows, dealers said.
Dealers said in late afternoon trading there was a strong outflow of dollars due to heavy import volume.
"The supply of dollars fell sharply in late session, triggering a drop in reais prices," a dealer said.

Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts at 1500 local/1800 GMT showed a Tuesday surplus of $53 million. Dealers noted, however, that the figure did not include import contracts.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real dropped a slight 0.01 percent to end at 1.0587 real per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 0.46 percent to end at 1.085 reais per greenback.
